paraphrase: The work declares its source: in the fifth Pūrva, in its tenth section (vastu), the third prābhṛta, called 'Pejja' (attachment), is the Prābhṛta of the Passions; it treats attachment and aversion (pejja, dosa) and the deluding karma — their bondage, duration, rise, subsidence and destruction.
notes: Paraphrase of the opening gāthā (moderate confidence).
